title: Prepayment Fee Measure for Parking License Security Prepayments
content:
**Prepayment fee** (Parking License collections). The monthly figure on which a security prepayment is measured — the security prepayment months are multiplied by it.

**Definition.** When a storage bundle discount credit was posted on the license within 1 month before the handling date and the lease holds an active storage rental, the prepayment fee is the most recent monthly fee line less the most recent storage bundle discount credit; when that is not the case and the license has been held fewer than 365 days, the prepayment fee is the product's monthly license fee; in every other case the prepayment fee is the monthly fee in force on the license.

- The storage rental is the lease's Storage Rental in active status.
- **Most recent monthly fee line** and **most recent storage bundle discount credit** are the latest of each posted on the license.
- **Days held** run from the license's start date to the handling date.

## Measure by case

| Storage bundle discount credit posted within 1 month before the handling date | Active Storage Rental on the lease | Days held | Prepayment fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | most recent monthly fee line less most recent storage bundle discount credit |
| yes | no | fewer than 365 | the product's monthly license fee |
| no | any | fewer than 365 | the product's monthly license fee |
| yes | no | 365 or more | the monthly fee in force on the license |
| no | any | 365 or more | the monthly fee in force on the license |

## Worked examples (hypothetical licenses)

- A Structured Garage Space license with an active Storage Rental whose most recent fee line of $95.00 received a storage bundle discount credit of $9.50 twelve days ago: prepayment fee $85.50.
- A license held 200 days with no recent storage bundle discount credit: the product's monthly license fee.
- A license held 800 days with no recent storage bundle discount credit and a monthly fee in force of $90.00: $90.00.
